name: sprint46_volspike_drift_spy_v7_params_fixed
hypothesis: After a 3x volume spike on a positive SPY 1m RTH bar, the following 30m drift is non-zero. This is the unscored mechanism left after loader defects in sprints 38-45.
power_argument: About 63 validation RTH days x cap 10 gives up to 630 trades (floor 300). SPY 30m sigma is ~20bp, so SE is ~1.15bp at n=300 and the minimum detectable edge at t=2 is ~2.3bp. T2 round-trip cost is ~26bp, so PASS needs gross above ~28bp, which can fail under the null. If n<300 on validation, mark UNPOWERED and do not score.
prerequisite: auditor dry-run n>0 on research and validation; C0/C1 pass on the current loader. If n=0, escalate and do not score.
